scenes.headline: How a model writes its own exam, then sits it
scenes.sub: Ornith-1.5: tasks, scaffolds and rollouts, trained by one reward.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Gnocchi! Ornith-1.5 is a family of open models trained by a loop that sets its own homework. Here's how.

scenes.text: RL usually has three fixed inputs: tasks, a harness and a policy. Here the model proposes the tasks, builds the scaffolds and solves them, under one reward.
scenes.say: The idea: reinforcement learning usually has fixed tasks and a fixed harness. Here the model proposes tasks, builds scaffolds, and solves them, under one reward.

steps.say: Given a codebase and its own history of solved tasks, the model proposes a new, harder task.
For that task, it writes scaffolds: instructions, tools and a plan of attack.
Conditioned on both, the policy produces solution rollouts.
One reward flows back through all three stages as a single GRPO update. It learns to solve, to set tasks, and to build scaffolds.

scenes.title: The task reward is a product
scenes.text: R_task = V x D x N
scenes.say: A proposer rewarded only for difficulty would write nonsense, so the task reward is a product.

parts.note: valid and verifiable? A hard gate
parts.say: V: is the task valid and verifiable? It's a hard gate. Zero here zeroes everything.

parts.note: difficulty: success rate near a target of 0.2
parts.say: D: the model's own success rate should sit near twenty percent.
N: is it new, against earlier tasks?

items.text: The model solves the task more often
items.say: As the model improves, its success rate on a task climbs past twenty percent.
So the reward for proposing that task falls.

items.text: The generator moves to harder problems
items.say: And the generator moves on to harder problems, with nobody maintaining a schedule.

scenes.title: What the loop moved, 397B
scenes.note: capability unlocked, or harness plumbing fixed? Unpublished
scenes.say: GPQA, a knowledge test, moved four point seven points. DeepSWE, an agentic one, went from eight to fifty-six: a real unlock, or a fixed harness. Nothing published says which.

scenes.text: With tasks and harnesses inside the loop, the curriculum becomes a function of the policy, not a constant beside it.

recap: The model proposes tasks and builds scaffolds
One GRPO reward trains all three stages
Difficulty near 0.2 keeps the curriculum climbing
scenes.say: To recap: it sets the task, builds the scaffold, sits the exam, and one reward teaches all three.
